attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1 using an Ansible playbook (installed ansible-core via apk, then ran the playbook locally with a localhost/local-connection inventory): created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, then recursively set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers and mode u=rwX,g=rX,o= (dirs 0750, files 0640) on /srv/inventory via the file module, preserving all existing data (config.json, records.csv unchanged). Functionally verified with temporary test users: a member of inventory-readers could read the files; a user outside the group was denied (ls and cat both failed with Permission denied). Test users were removed afterward. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on both node1 and node2: captured pre-restart boot_id and health, rebooted each node one at a time via background `reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed a changed boot_id proving a real restart, and reverified /srv/inventory ownership/permissions/data integrity on node1 and basic health on node2 post-restart.
